proposed_capability: MoonWake /sixth-gear P141→P95→P82→P08→P07→P124. Correct blanket school-premises homework denial when an exact-build, same-capture live interaction demonstrates an admissible homework opportunity at class boundary; maintain real class attendance and player queue. Connect observed targeted chat whims to matching Sims-library identities and safe on-lot conversation or R Relationships chat/invite route, not just whim pin advice. Integrate with existing host_stack and opt-in host_listener without inventing EA native effects or uncensored screen input.
player_save_control_impact: No new host OS effects, input hooks, network, automatic screenshot capture, uncontrolled clicks, save-file reads, queue cancellation, skipped classes or retroactively assumed homework completion. A fresh source-qualified homework affordance and verified class attendance preservation may conditionally override old school-premises policy for an advisory only. Exact target and independent relationship list required for chat; unknown or ambiguous people abstain; occult unknown denies invite home. Player-directed queue, busy state, critical survival needs and action provenance outrank suggestions.
expected_outcome: Conditional late-homework continuation and start recommendation at class transition with observed available interaction; safe target-specific chat-whim plan using on-lot vs R Relationships observed affordances, dedup and queue capacity. Host-stack and listener pass observations through, emit next-action candidate gate. CLI for bounded local evaluator and regression suite. Actual EA native tuning/Script implementation requires local exact-build evidence; preserve BI-002 active.
negative_tests: No homework window evidence retains prior school blocking
Wrong or stale game build/capture/phase or unverified class attendance denies late homework
Player commands and class attendance cannot be canceled, overwritten or blindly delayed
Repeated homework queue cannot produce duplicate admission
Critical needs, busy Sim or unavailable queue prevent homework start
Missing homework book or unknown Sim location denies positive affordance
Chat whim target may not be invented from generic text or guessed relationship list
Ambiguous Sims names, mismatched IDs or stale capture deny chat
Already queued same-target chat yields no duplicate
Off-lot relationship chat route requires observed R panel affordance
Unknown/vampire occult blocks home invite; on-lot safe chat isn't a home invite
Malformed listener observation or arbitrary action text denies
No actual game click, screenshot capture or keyboard dispatch from offline planner
rollback_path: Revert dedicated feature PR. Existing school-day and social opportunity effects remain unchanged absent opt-in observation; no EA/game-save/OS settings modified. BI-002 hunger game gate independent.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact installed The Sims 4 build and source-calibrated homework during class require P08 on local Windows Sims
Available relationship chat menu/action can vary by packs/patch; R hotkey is known but live focus/calibration unverified
Current host_stack and host_listener are source advisory, not installed game-native EA mod
Native EA tuning/hook integration for actual queue effects is not proven
BI-002 hunger A/B and rollback still ACTIVE
decision_rationale: P141 compared hard universal school block (rejected from contradictory operator observation), hard unconditional exploit even when class marked active (rejected for missed attendance), speculative UI spam/clicker (rejected per game-native doctrine), and fresh native-affordance qualification of the school transition plus target-verified social chat whim routing through existing owner (selected). P95 designs conditional read-only plan; P82 falsifies with adversarial tests; P08 cannot certify The Sims 4 gameplay via GitHub; P07 builds integrated host code and tests; P124 ensures no duplicate schedulers/queue controllers and stable evidence/proof semantics.
